newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 18.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Commentary hails achievements of 10 large state-owned enterprises in deepening reforms and increasing economic returns.
- Report focuses on Handan Iron and Steel Corp's success in increasing steel output while lowering production costs.
- Xinhua commentator repudiates Dalai Lama's remarks over recent years that encourage separatism under the guise of negotiations.
- President Jiang Zemin says his upcoming summit with Russian President Boris Yeltsin will be of great significance and his trip to Moscow will reap positive results
- End end-1996, Agriculture Bank of China's foreign exchange assets rech $7.7 billion
- State Economic and Trade Commission forecasts April industrial output to rise 12.5 percent
- Demand for household appliances rises in first quarter, demand for refrigerators seen at 6.7 million, washing machines 16.1 million, colour televisions 15.6 million, air conditioners 5.7 million
- Guangzi Liuzhou steel export up 23 percent in 1996
- China's private industries 820,000 at end 1996, up 25.17 percent
- Chinese Islamic Association says none of 5,000 Chinese Moslem pilgrims to Mecca killed or injured in blaze that hit the annual haj pilgrimage
- China joins world's top 10 in amount of income from tourism, and the booming tourist trade turns China into number five destination spot across globe.
